other_conditions: Must be a bonafide Himachali student
Must not have availed any other interest subsidy on education loans under any other scheme of the State Government or Government of India
Loan must be for professional/technical or higher education courses from recognized institutions in India
Education loan must be disbursed on or after 01.04.2016
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy of up to 4% per annum on education loans up to ₹10 lakhs for eligible Himachali students.
